name: Canada
disclaimer: General information to help you organise your record. It is not legal advice. Most workplaces are covered by provincial or territorial law; federal law covers banks, airlines, telecoms, federal government and some others. Time limits differ by province.

lawyerHelp.label: Find a lawyer through your provincial law society

statutes.name: Provincial and territorial human rights laws (for example the Ontario Human Rights Code)
statutes.summary: Protect against discrimination and harassment at work on grounds such as race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, religion and family status, and against reprisal for complaining.

agency.name: Your provincial or territorial human rights tribunal or commission

limitation.label: Apply to your human rights tribunal
limitation.note: In most provinces, one year from the incident or the last of a series of incidents. Check your province: some differ.

statutes.name: Canadian Human Rights Act (federally regulated workplaces)
statutes.summary: Protects employees of federally regulated employers from discrimination and harassment on prohibited grounds.

limitation.label: Complain to the Canadian Human Rights Commission
limitation.note: Within one year of the last incident. The Commission can sometimes accept a later complaint.

statutes.name: Canada Labour Code Part III (federally regulated workplaces)
statutes.summary: Non-managerial employees with 12 months' service can complain about unjust dismissal. Part III also covers wages, hours and leave.

agency.name: Labour Program, Employment and Social Development Canada

limitation.label: Make an unjust dismissal complaint
limitation.note: Within 90 days of being dismissed. Wage and other Part III complaints generally allow six months.

statutes.name: Occupational health and safety laws (Canada Labour Code Part II and provincial acts)
statutes.summary: Employers must keep workplaces safe and prevent harassment and violence. Workers who raise safety concerns or refuse unsafe work are protected from reprisal.

agency.name: Your provincial health and safety regulator, or the federal Labour Program

limitation.label: Make a reprisal complaint
limitation.note: For federally regulated workplaces, within 90 days. Provincial limits vary.

support.name: 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline
support.description: Free support any time, in English or French.

support.name: Canadian Mental Health Association
support.description: Local mental health services and information.
